classes.tacticalIdentity: Hybrid Martial/Mystic attacker whose equipped relic or conventional weapon determines the legal Art mix.
classes.resourceBehavior: Uses shared AP and personal MP together; cannot substitute free weapon Arts for exhausted Mystic resources.
classes.learningProfile: Unlocks through meaningful use of both a weapon discipline and a Mystic discipline; grows poorly if only one half is used.
equipmentInteractions: equipped weapon family selects the legal Combat Art tree
hybrid relics broaden forecasts but never make member Arts clickable
aiPredictionRules: prefer legal mixed forecasts when AP and MP support both halves
fallback to the equipped weapon tree without overspending MP
classes.beginnerTrap: Hybrid access can dilute mastery if the player constantly changes training focus.
classes.balanceLimit: Never exceeds a dedicated Warrior in sustained break damage or a dedicated Mage in pure Mystic output.
classes.unlockRule: Achieve meaningful rank 3 in one weapon tree and one offensive Mystic tree on the same character.

classes.tacticalIdentity: Sustaining protector who combines Guard, Restoration, barriers, and reach weapons.
classes.resourceBehavior: Conserves personal MP for actual missing-HP recovery or dangerous incoming attacks.
classes.learningProfile: Unlocks by preventing meaningful damage and restoring endangered allies in the same operations.
equipmentInteractions: shield and Warding equipment improve prevention
staff or focus equipment improves Restoration reach
aiPredictionRules: prefer mixed protect-and-heal forecasts when one member can hold pressure
classes.beginnerTrap: Too many defensive members can leave the Union unable to finish battles.
classes.balanceLimit: Protection and healing require real incoming danger; harmless farming grants no mastery.
classes.unlockRule: Prevent meaningful damage with Guard/Warding and restore missing HP in five equal-or-harder encounters.

classes.tacticalIdentity: Forecast specialist who improves information, AP use, formations, objectives, and multi-Union coordination.
classes.resourceBehavior: Reduces wasted AP through clearer legal fallbacks rather than creating free AP.
classes.learningProfile: Unlocks through varied successful forecasts, objective contribution, and formation recovery.
equipmentInteractions: signal and engineering tools add objective forecasts
foci support precise Support and Aether options
aiPredictionRules: increase forecast clarity, never secretly alter resolved results
coordinate multiple Unions only through authoritative commands
classes.beginnerTrap: A Tactician cannot compensate for a Union that lacks damage, protection, or healing tools.
classes.balanceLimit: Command bonuses improve legal choice quality but cannot reroll unchanged forecasts.
classes.unlockRule: Complete twelve distinct meaningful forecast intents and three operation objectives with the same character.

classes.tacticalIdentity: High-risk breaker who converts pressure, missing HP, and enemy focus into escalating Martial offense.
classes.resourceBehavior: Spends AP aggressively and may use personal MP for Flame, Storm, or Shadow enhancements.
classes.learningProfile: Unlocks through meaningful Cohesion breaks while surviving dangerous retaliation; self-inflicted harmless loops do not count.
equipmentInteractions: great weapons and axes amplify break pressure
heavy armor reduces risk but also lowers some momentum weights
aiPredictionRules: never choose a suicidal action when a legal survival fallback exists
show the risk clearly in the complete forecast
classes.beginnerTrap: All-out forecasts can strand the Union without AP or expose healers.
classes.balanceLimit: Missing-HP bonuses are capped and cannot create infinite damage or intentional friendly-fire farming.
classes.unlockRule: Break five equal-or-harder enemy formations and survive three critical-HP turns without retreating.
